workflow_lessons: Preserve immutable producer freezes and receipt public hygiene projections separately.
Scan path leakage after line-wrap normalization, not only literal whole-line matching.
Normalize Zenodo checksum algorithm prefixes before comparing deposition and records API values.
Publish direct single-file PDF and cumulative TeX downloads while grouping ledgers and render evidence.
Publish project-generated target/QA images with stable IDs while excluding rights-unclear source pixels.
Keep SGA1 and SGA2 authority spans and continuation cursors separate and explicit.
When a Zenodo record remains well below its file-count limit, expose each current reader's cumulative TeX directly instead of forcing source discovery inside ZIPs.
